name: @singulink/steno
description: The TypeScript reference implementation of the Steno Encoding, a compact encoding of Unicode text whose bytes sort like the text.
author: Singulink

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/clean.mjs build-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.test:types: npm run build && node scripts/type-examples.mjs && tsc -p test-types/tsconfig.dom.json && tsc -p test-types/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.bench: npm run build && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=512 bench/run.mjs && node bench/report.mjs --readme
scripts.bench:smoke: npm run build && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=512 bench/run.mjs --smoke && node bench/report.mjs --smoke
